encounter: Mind Badge chapter cap 60 - Magma Hideout raid (play_order 210-216, E0321-E0327)
availability_audit: Every member's pool-60 source map precedes the Magma Hideout, which the brief places after the Mt Pyre summit and before the Aqua Hideout and Mossdeep. Amoonguss gate 42 (Foongus line). Incineroar gate 36 (Litten line). Urshifu-Rapid-Strike gate 42 (evolution:other:EVO_SCRIPT_TRIGGER from Kubfu). Gardevoir gate 30 (Kirlia line) with ITEM_GARDEVOIRITE stone-window 14. Zapdos gate 30, legendary_sign:NewMauville_Inside. Swampert gate 36 (Mudkip line). One reachable legend. Nothing is sourced from Shoal Cave, Route 124-127, Mossdeep, the Aqua Hideout or the Safari Zone, so this party is honest for the first room of the raid as well as the last.
plan: Seven rooms of Ground, Rock, Fire, Poison, Steel and Dark, with two sand engines, one Trick Room, one Tailwind and three separate setup lanes. The spine is coverage that every room fears at once. Urshifu-Rapid is the best single answer in the raid: Surging Strikes always crits so it ignores a Coil, a Shell Smash or a Shift Gear the room has already banked, Water is 2x into the Fire, Rock and Ground bodies and Fighting is 2x into the Steel and Dark ones, and Unseen Fist goes straight through the Protect that every one of these rooms carries. Zapdos is immune to Ground, which is the single most common attacking type down here, and its Heat Wave answers the Steel and Bug lanes. Mega Gardevoir's Psyshock is 2x into every Poison body in the hideout and Moonblast is 2x into the Dark ones. Amoonguss Spores the setter and its Grass half is 2x into Ground and Rock. Swampert is the bulky second Water/Ground. Incineroar supplies Fake Out, Knock Off and Parting Shot - note that its Intimidate must be held back in E0326, where Bisharp's Defiant turns a stat drop into +2 Attack.
